pieces.find: He belonged to the sakhā of Lord Nityānanda. He was a brāhmaṇa from Navadvīpa
pieces.end: Viṣṇudāsa Ācārya He belonged to the spiritual lineage
pieces.heading: ## VIṢṆUDĀSA ĀCĀRYA (NITYĀNANDA'S BRANCH)
pieces.title: Viṣṇudāsa Ācārya (Nityānanda's branch)

fields.notes: Of Nityānanda's branch; a brāhmaṇa of Navadvīpa, brother of Nandana Ācārya. Not Viṣṇudāsa Ācārya of Advaita's branch.
